verdict.rationale: ADK's Workflow Runtime documents fan-out/fan-in, loops, and retry primitives that could be used to process many items in bulk within an agent workflow, but there's no explicit documentation, example, or first-party feature demonstrating bulk operations across many items as a user-facing capability. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation examples/docs, evidence of scale (many items processed concurrently), and any hands-on demonstration of batch processing rather than just generic workflow primitives.
